You are working in the live Next.js (App Router) codebase at /opt/nxeon for "Nxeon" (nxeon.cloud), a VPS/shared-hosting/game-server platform. Your job: implement a technical SEO package. Make SOURCE edits only. Do NOT run `npm run build` or `scripts/promote-production.sh` (builds in the live tree are forbidden per project rules). You MAY run `npx tsc --noEmit` or `npx next lint` to typecheck if quick. Report back a concise summary + the list of files changed with a short diff-style description of each change.

Context from Google Search Console: new domain, high impressions/low clicks, avg position ~51. We want structured data + internal linking to help indexing and CTR. Existing structured data lives in `components/marketing/StructuredData.tsx` (currently Organization/WebSite JSON-LD) and is used in `app/(marketing)/tools/page.tsx` and `components/marketing/ToolShell.tsx`. Blog posts exist (200 SEO posts in DB) but the blog post ROUTE FILE is NOT at `app/(marketing)/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` — you must FIND the real blog post route first (try: grep for "BlogPosting", "generateMetadata" under app/, find files matching **/blog/**, search for where blog posts are rendered from the DB, likely a `[slug]` dynamic route somewhere under app/). 

Tasks (do as many as safely apply; skip gracefully with a note if a file/route genuinely doesn't exist):
1. LOCATE the blog post detail route and the blog index route. Report their paths.
2. Add **Article/BlogPosting JSON-LD** to the blog post detail page (headline, description, datePublished/dateModified, author=Nxeon, image if available, mainEntityOfPage, publisher with logo). Reuse/extend the existing StructuredData component pattern rather than inventing a new one. Ensure it's server-rendered.
3. Add **Product JSON-LD** to the main product/pricing pages (VPS plans, shared hosting plans, game hosting) — name, description, offers with price + priceCurrency USD + availability. Find the pricing/product pages under app/(marketing). Use real plan data if easily accessible; otherwise a representative Product/Offer per product line.
4. Add **FAQPage JSON-LD** wherever there is an existing FAQ section on marketing pages (search for "faq" / "FAQ" components). Only mark up FAQs that actually render on the page (Google requires visible content).
5. **Internal linking**: on the blog post detail page, add a "Related posts" or "Related articles" block (3-6 links to other posts, e.g. same category or most recent) AND ensure blog posts link to a relevant product page (e.g. game posts → game hosting, vps posts → vps). Also ensure the blog index is linked from the main marketing nav/footer if it isn't already. This is the biggest lever for the 61 "Discovered - not indexed" pages.
6. Fix the single 404: check `app/robots` / sitemap and look for any obviously broken internal link. If you can't identify the specific 404 URL without GSC access, note that and skip.
7. Ensure each blog post has a unique <title> and meta description via generateMetadata (canonical too). Verify this already works or add it.

Constraints: match existing code style/conventions exactly. Keep JSON-LD via `<script type="application/ld+json">` with dangerouslySetInnerHTML, server component. Do not touch billing/charge logic. Do not deploy. Do not commit. When done, give me: (a) blog route paths found, (b) per-task what you changed or why you skipped, (c) files touched, (d) whether tsc passed.

## Summary

The codebase already had solid SEO groundwork (a `StructuredData` component with `Article`/`FAQ`/`Product` helpers, per-post `generateMetadata` with canonical, blog in nav + footer, blog posts in the sitemap). I closed the real gaps: missing internal linking on posts, missing Product/FAQ markup on several key pages, and thin Article markup.

### (a) Blog route paths found
- **Post detail:** `/opt/nxeon/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx`
- **Blog index:** `/opt/nxeon/app/blog/page.tsx`
- Data layer: `/opt/nxeon/lib/blog.ts`; sitemap `/opt/nxeon/app/sitemap.ts` (already includes published posts); robots `/opt/nxeon/app/robots.ts`.

### (b) Per-task
1. **Locate routes** — done (above).
2. **Article/BlogPosting JSON-LD** — already present via `ArticleJsonLd`; extended it to add `mainEntityOfPage` and `image` (cover image, normalized to absolute URL), and switched publisher logo from `favicon.svg` to `/logo.png` (raster, Google-eligible, consistent with the Organization block). Server-rendered.
3. **Product JSON-LD** — VPS was only on `/pricing`; added the VPS `ProductJsonLd` to the primary `/vps` landing page. Added a new generic `ProductOffersJsonLd` and wired it into **web-hosting** (shared hosting, live DB plans) and **GameLandingPage** (all game-server SEO landers, prices parsed from display strings). All emit `AggregateOffer` with `priceCurrency: USD` + `InStock`.
4. **FAQPage JSON-LD** — most pages already had it via shared layouts. Found and fixed three flagship pages that render a visible FAQ but had no markup: **`/vps`, `/domains`, `/migrate`** (their existing `{q,a}` arrays are reused, so markup matches visible content).
5. **Internal linking (biggest lever)** — added to the post detail page: a **"Related articles"** block (3 posts, same-category-first with newest-post backfill via new `getRelatedPosts`) and a **contextual product CTA** that maps each post to the most relevant money page (new `productLinkForPost`: game→/game-servers, web→/web-hosting, domain→/domains, email→/business-email, else→/vps). Blog was already linked from nav and footer.
6. **404 fix** — Could not identify the specific URL without GSC access, so skipped per instructions. Verified sitemap/robots are sane (robots correctly disallows the retired `/docs`) and that every internal link I introduced resolves to an existing route. **Owner action: paste the 404 URL from GSC and I'll fix the specific link.**
7. **Unique title/description/canonical** — already implemented in `generateMetadata` (seoTitle/seoDescription fallbacks + `alternates.canonical`). Verified working; additionally added OG/Twitter `images` from the cover image.
